messages:
Elaine (product): Heads-up — enterprise RFP asking for per-route softcap + automatic crediting if we breach latency SLAs. Can we workshop constraints?
Marco (sales): They want 3 softcaps: API, embeddings, streaming. Also asked for 'no surprise' overage credits w/ monthly reconciliation.
Sophie (legal): Need exact language on what triggers a credit. 'If p95 latency > target for >5% of requests for a billing window' is doable but needs thresholds.
Kevin (finance): Credits impact revenue recognition. We can do a capped credit pool per contract (e.g., max 5% of monthly invoice). Anything open-ended is risky.
Ryan (eng): Implementation wise, per-route meters exist but streaming latency measurement differs. We can emit per-route p95 and hit counts; auto-crediting needs a reconciliation job + approval flow.
Elaine (product): Proposal: define softcap for each route, a monitored SLO, and a contract clause: automatic credit up to X% monthly or manual review for exceptions. Thoughts?
Marco (sales): Sales needs model options: (A) auto-credit up to 3% invoice, (B) larger cap with manual ops review, (C) credits only for repeated breaches. Pick A to close.
Sophie (legal): Draft phrasing: "Customer credit will be provided when Redwood's measured route-level SLO breach exceeds the agreed threshold. Credit = min(agreed cap, calculated impact)." Need to define "calculated impact" explicitly.
Kevin (finance): "Calculated impact" should map to measurable metrics we can monetize: e.g., proportion of tokens affected * unit rate. Keep it simple for audits.
Ryan (eng): Practically: we emit metrics: route.total_tokens, route.breached_tokens, p95_latency. Credit calc = (breached_tokens / total_tokens) * bill_amount * credit_factor. We can ship metric export and a small lambda to compute.
Elaine (product): Ok — action items: @Ryan to prototype metric export + credit script, @Sophie to draft contract clause with measurable triggers, @Kevin to model revenue impact for 3% and 5% caps, @Marco to test whether A closes the deal.
ops-bot: Deployment pipeline for metric-exporter scheduled at 2026-05-03T09:00Z (ticket INF-4021).
Marco (sales): One more ask from customer: ability to carve out internal dev traffic from softcap calculations. Is that doable?
Ryan (eng): We can support an allowlist of client_ids to exclude from metrics. Needs a config flag per tenant. Low effort.
Sophie (legal): Require auditable exclusion rationale — customers must declare excluded client IDs in contract schedule.
Kevin (finance): If exclusions are allowed, credits should be calculated on post-exclusion usage. Confirmed.
Elaine (product): Timeline: prototype in 2 weeks, legal draft in 1 week, finance impact model in 3 days. If sales confirms A, prioritize.
Marco (sales): I'll push for A. If they counter for higher cap, will flag.
Ryan (eng): Noted. I'll put a small PoC patch in a feature branch and share logs.
Sophie (legal): I'll post a redline tomorrow.
Elaine (product): Great — thanks all. We'll sync in the weekly roadmap meeting if anything major shifts. :thumbsup:
